items.title: 52145_Andrew Blakeney oral history interview
items.q: The daughters were schoolteachers; Hilda, Gloria

ctx.x: Spencer Johnson; he had a son who was a musician also, Carl. The daughters were schoolteachers; Hilda, Gloria and one other daughter. He was the president prior to Mr. Bailey.
Mr. Blakeney, would you state for us, if you can recall, the attitude of the community towards the musician at that time; how was the musician looked upon by the non-professionals in the community?
